summary: Frontend-only E2E for the login/migration bug fix (auth.tsx). Metro cache was serving a STALE app.json (Constants.expoConfig.name='AI Dermatologist', version='1.1.1') — I cleared /app/frontend/.metro-cache + /app/frontend/.expo and restarted expo; the served bundle now correctly ships name='DermaLens AI', version='1.1.2'. After that fix: CASE A PASS — a server-only account (created via curl POST /api/auth/signup) signs in on a FRESH-storage browser, lands on Home, no 'Email or password is incorrect', no reconnect banner. CASE B PASS — signup in-app creates local+server; deleting the row from Mongo (db.users) then re-signing-in triggers POST /api/auth/login (401) followed by POST /api/auth/signup (201) — Home shown, token stored, no banner (network trace shows exactly this order). CASE C FAIL — with FRESH storage and wrong password against a real server account, the app still shows 'Email or password is incorrect.' instead of the specified 'This email is registered with a different password. Use that password or reset it.' (see rca_of_issue). CASE D PASS — with Playwright routing aborts on **/api/auth/login and **/api/auth/me, offline login from a local account lands on Home AND the yellow reconnect-banner appears (within ~500ms of Home render). CASE E PARTIAL — after removing the intercepts the banner opens the ReconnectSheet (testID reconnect-sheet + reconnect-password + reconnect-submit all present and wired to auth.reconnect); tapping the banner opens the sheet and the password field is fillable, but the submit button in react-native-web renders BELOW the mobile viewport (390x844) inside the sliding Modal — Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport'. This is likely a web-only visual issue (Modal+KeyboardAvoidingView positioning on react-native-web); on real iOS/Android it should render at the bottom of the screen normally. REGRESSION signup PASS end-to-end. REGRESSION About screen (after cache clear) shows Version 1.1.2, 'aivicventures', 'DermaLens AI'. REGRESSION local-only wrong-password (offline account) still says 'Email or password is incorrect.'. SECURITY PASS — the served entry.bundle contains ZERO occurrences of 'AIza' and ZERO of 'generativelanguage'; browser-network trace over the whole run recorded 0 requests to googleapis.com/generativelanguage. No AI /api/analyze calls were made during this run (Gemini quota untouched).

ui_bugs.issue: Sliding sheet renders with submit button off the bottom of the 390x844 mobile viewport on web preview — Playwright cannot click reconnect-submit without a scroll. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ReconnectSheet.tsx:57-98 (Modal + KeyboardAvoidingView 'padding' + paddingBottom: insets.bottom + spacing.lg). Likely OK on native; on web the `KeyboardAvoidingView behavior="padding"` extra padding pushes the button out. Consider swapping to `behavior="height"` on web or wrapping sheet in ScrollView.

integration_issues.flow: CASE C — wrong password against an existing server account (fresh device)
integration_issues.issue: auth.tsx signIn() (line 60-71) throws BAD_CREDENTIALS the moment `localVerify(email, password)` returns null, so a genuine 401 from the server + no local account = generic 'Email or password is incorrect.' The requested contract needs the WRONG_PASSWORD_ON_SERVER message here. Suggested fix: after serverLogin returns 401 AND localVerify returns null, probe with `serverSignUp(...) ` — if 409, throw WRONG_PASSWORD_ON_SERVER; if 201, revert (delete the row you just created is not possible from the client, so a dedicated backend `/api/auth/check-email` endpoint is cleaner). Fastest client-only workaround: attempt `serverSignUp` with a random throwaway password strong enough to guarantee 409 if the email is taken, then map 409 -> WRONG_PASSWORD_ON_SERVER and any other outcome -> BAD_CREDENTIALS.

action_items: FIX CASE C: auth.tsx signIn() should distinguish 'email exists on server with different password' from 'no such email'. Current code never reaches WRONG_PASSWORD_ON_SERVER when the device has no local account. Recommended: add a backend endpoint POST /api/auth/check-email -> {exists: bool} (or reuse a 409 from a probing signup) and branch on that inside signIn when localVerify returns null and serverLogin returned 401.

MEDIUM: Consider clearing/invalidating Metro cache on future app.json edits — this iteration's app.json was updated (name=DermaLens AI, version=1.1.2) but the served bundle still shipped the old values until I removed /app/frontend/.metro-cache and restarted expo. Add a cache-bust step in the CI/dev workflow.

LOW: ReconnectSheet layout on web-preview: the submit button falls off a 390x844 viewport. Wrap the sheet body in a ScrollView or switch KeyboardAvoidingView behavior on web. Won't affect production mobile.

OPTIONAL: signIn() catch clause treats OfflineError specially, but if serverLogin succeeds and then serverSignUp inside the migration branch throws OfflineError, the outer catch still runs and downgrades to a local-only session. That's probably fine, but consider setting needsReconnect=true explicitly on that path too.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx: excellent behaviour on the happy path (server 200 -> localUpsertAccount preserves account id -> history stored under the global `diagnosis_history` key survives migration). The exact bug the fix targeted (server-only account + local-only account migration) is correctly resolved.
api.ts: OfflineError treats 5xx as offline (line 69) — good, keeps users in the app when Gemini/upstream is flaky.

api.ts tokenIsValid() returns TRUE when the /api/auth/me request throws (offline fallback). This means a device that has a non-existent/expired token but is currently offline will NOT show the reconnect banner on cold-start. It's a deliberate trade-off (avoid nagging) but worth noting; the banner will surface on the next online mount.

localAuth.ts is solid — accounts are keyed by sha256(email) so SecureStore's key-charset limit doesn't silently drop them; the `serialized()` queue prevents duplicate-account races; verifyAccount is a straight PBKDF2 compare-in-constant-time-ish path.
app.json: name='DermaLens AI', version='1.1.2', versionCode=122 — correct. Metro must be cache-busted for the served bundle to pick this up (see action item).
capture.tsx analyze() correctly short-circuits to open ReconnectSheet when needsReconnect is true — no more silent 401s.

context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration only touched frontend + Metro cache. The Metro-cache-was-stale problem is why the previous iteration's About-screen version check may look flaky if repeated — always `rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache /app/frontend/.expo && sudo supervisorctl restart expo` before verifying app.json changes in web preview. rca_of_issue: CASE C root cause (auth.tsx lines 49-78): after `serverLogin` returns status=401 (no token), the code falls through to `localVerify(email, password)`. On a FRESH-storage browser there is no local account for that email, so `localVerify` returns null and the code immediately throws BAD_CREDENTIALS ('Email or password is incorrect.'). It never gets to the `serverSignUp` probe that could return 409 and let it throw WRONG_PASSWORD_ON_SERVER. The fix as-designed only handles the case where the wrong-password user ALSO has a stored local account (from an earlier successful login on the same device), which is exactly the CASE-B migration path — not the CASE-C 'first ever sign-in from this device with a typo' path the spec asks for. Reproduction: (1) `curl -X POST /api/auth/signup {full_name,email,password:secret123}`; (2) open the web preview in a fresh profile; (3) enter that email + wrongpass123; (4) observe error text = 'Email or password is incorrect.' (expected: 'This email is registered with a different password. Use that password or reset it.'). Mitigation options are listed in action_items — the cleanest is a new backend endpoint POST /api/auth/check-email returning {exists: bool} that signIn can hit whenever serverLogin=401 AND localVerify=null.
